ios.desc:
Log the books you read aloud to your baby, including favorite repeats. Record the reader and language for each session, and see reading history for each child.

No Baby Book Tracker account required. No ads. Reading records stay on your device by default.

FEATURES:
• Barcode Scanner: Scan an ISBN to look up book details online. Edit the result or add a book manually if the edition is missing.
• Multilingual Tracking: Log readings across different languages—ideal for bilingual families.
• Multiple Readers & Babies: Track who read what (Mom, Dad, grandparents) with separate profiles for each child.
• Reading Stats: Track total books read, reading streaks, and all-time favorites.
• 1,000 Books Goal: Track progress toward the 1,000 Books Before Kindergarten challenge, with a deadline and completion bar.
• Digital Bookmark: Record your progress and resume reading right where you stopped.
• Borrowed Book Reminders: Mark library books as borrowed and get a return reminder before they're due.
• Daily Reading Reminder: An optional gentle nudge to log today's story.
• Local Reading Records: Your reading log stays on your device by default, with optional private iCloud sync. Crash diagnostics and purchase processing are described in our privacy policy.

FREE TO TRY, THEN A SINGLE PAID UNLOCK:
• Free: Track up to 3 books to test the scanner, stats, and library completely free.
• Full Access: A single one-time in-app purchase unlocks unlimited books, forever. No subscription.
• Family Sharing supported: One purchase covers both parents across their Apple devices.

quotes.text:
I'm a new dad and started reading to my son from birth. I got into the 1000 books by 5 years challenge and wanted a simple way to track what I read to him. Existing apps felt too dated and clunky, so I built my own.

Built this to solve my own problem:
- Quick logging (date, book, reader, language)
- Scan or add your own book manually
- Simple stats on reading streaks and frequency
- Works for multiple kids and multilingual families

iOS only for now (built with React Native). Sign up on the site if you want an Android version: https://babybooktracker.montalesi.dev

iOS link here: https://apps.apple.com/app/baby-book-tracker/id6758372334

Would love feedback from other parents who read to their babies.
